g.text: Simple double bearing V2 / Production mesh sections / Dimensions in mm
Face views: solid = mounting or journal face; dotted = opposite face. Grid spacing 7.5 mm. Mount holes Ø3.60; tie holes Ø3.40 on radius 6.52.
Print broad face down. Load the four mount nuts before closing each E/N pair. The narrowest end-journal web is 0.27 mm at the default dimensions.
